card.name: Just before a male relative's name
card.fires_on: A comma or word right after a male family member (son, brother) where a man's first name is about to be given. Also fires after verbs like 'going with' or 'called' before a male name.

modes.label: Son or brother, then name
modes.description: The word son or brother, or the comma after it, comes just before the relative's first name.
modes.example: her seven-year-old<< son>>, Brian, but in February, Brian

modes.label: Verb before a male name
modes.description: A verb or linking word where a man's first name comes next.
modes.example: "Is Gina going<< with>> Jim? I see them together all

modes.label: Comma before listed names
modes.description: A comma after a family noun that introduces named male relatives.
modes.example: they have two sons<<,>> Kaarlo and Olavi.

card.writes: It pushes common male first names such as William, James and John, and pushes down female names such as Maria and Anna.
card.plain: It signals that a man's first name is coming next, usually after a mention of a son or brother.
